## <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/-CORE_SYSTEMS_&_ARCHITECTURE-0D1117?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZpZXdCb3g9IjAgMCAyNCAyNCIgZmlsbD0ibm9uZSIgc3Ryb2tlPSIjNEFERThBIiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjIuNCIgc3Ryb2tlLWxpbmVjYXA9InJvdW5kIiBzdHJva2UtbGluZWpvaW49InJvdW5kIj48cG9seWxpbmUgcG9pbnRzPSIyMiAxMiAxOCAxMiAxNSAyMSA5IDMgNiAxMiAyIDEyIi8+PC9zdmc+" height="24" />

### 1. Sub-Second YouTube Telemetry Engine (Keyless InnerTube Pipeline)
* **Zero API Key Required:** Connects directly to any YouTube Live URL (`watch?v=`, `/live/`, `youtu.be/`, or 11-character video ID) without needing a Google Cloud API key or quota.
* **Dedicated Live Watching HUD (`live_watching`):** Tracks the exact number of concurrent viewers currently watching the broadcast in real time (`0.8s` parallel telemetry interval) with a pulsing live indicator dot.
* **Cumulative Total Views HUD (`viewer_count`):** Combines YouTube's cumulative view endpoints with a real-time viewer arrival accumulator so total stream views increment immediately as new viewers join and never drop when concurrent viewers leave.
* **Exact Unrounded Likes & Subscribers (`like_count`, `subscriber_count`):** Parses exact integers from YouTube accessibility payloads and `frameworkUpdates` entities so every single like and subscriber change appears immediately without being stuck on rounded `1.2K` strings.
* **Channel & Broadcast Telemetry:** Includes dedicated HUD elements for **Live Indicator**, **Channel Name**, **Channel Handle (`@handle`)**, **Stream Duration Timer (`HH:MM:SS`)**, **Stream Title**, and **Connection Status**.

## <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/-LEFT--GLIDE_LIVE_CHAT_&_ANIMATION_SYSTEM-0D1117?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64," height="24" />

### 2. 6 Selectable Left-to-Right Chat Animations & Adaptive Queue Pacing
* **Guaranteed Left-Side Entrance:** Every incoming live chat message enters from the left side of the chat box with a glowing cyan leading edge, smooth sub-pixel translation, and exponential vertical push damping for older messages.
* **6 Selectable Animation Modes:**
  * **`Left Slide`** — Classic cubic ease-out horizontal glide from the left edge.
  * **`Left Pop`** — Horizontal left slide combined with a liquid spring scale pop (`0.68x` to `1.0x`).
  * **`Left Spring`** — Fast left-to-right entrance with a soft spring overshoot and settle.
  * **`Left Bounce`** — Left-side entrance paired with a smooth vertical sine-arc bounce.
  * **`Left Wave`** — Quartic diagonal wave entrance with subtle scale lift.
  * **`Left Fade`** — Cinema-grade soft horizontal drift and alpha fade-in.
* **Adaptive Auto-Pacing Queue:** Even when Chat Delay is set to `0.0s`, burst batches of incoming messages are automatically spaced (`95ms–260ms`) so messages never dump on the same frame and every single comment plays its entrance animation smoothly.
* **Rich Chat Customizations:**
  * Custom **Animation Speed (`0.5x` – `2.5x`)**, **Chat Delay (`0.0s` – `2.0s`)**, and **Chat Text Size (`0.5x` – `2.6x`)**.
  * Custom vector **YouTube Badge**, **Role Badges** (Streamer/Owner Gold, Moderator Blue, Member Green), **Vibrant Colored Usernames**, **Multi-Color Chat**, **RGB Chroma Mode**, **Line Background Pill**, **Newest Chat at Top/Bottom**, and **Live Chat History Scrolling** (`Up Arrow` / `Down Arrow`).

## <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/-WORLD_LANGUAGE_&_BENGALI_HD_AKSHAR_ENGINE-0D1117?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64," height="24" />

### 3. Pre-Baked 2D Bengali Akshar Atlas & Vector Emoji Renderer
* **Full-HD Bengali Conjunct & Matra Shaping (`BengaliFontEngine`):** Renders Bengali vowels, consonants, kar/matra reorderings (`ি`, `ে`, `ৈ`, `ো`, `ৌ`), Reph (`র্`), Ya-phala (`্য`), Ra-phala (`্র`), and complex conjuncts (`যুক্তবর্ণ`) at `0.285x` sub-pixel HD resolution without broken glyphs.
* **Multi-Script Shaping (`WorldLanguageShaper`):** Includes automatic normalization and vowel reordering for Devanagari/Hindi and bidirectional shaping for RTL scripts.
* **Custom Vector Color Emojis (`EmojiRenderer`):** Built-in vector renderer for YouTube shortcodes, custom channel emotes, hearts, fire, faces, and regional flags (`BD`, `IN`, etc.).

## <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/-INTERACTIVE_HUD_EDITOR_&_LIQUID_GLASS_UI-0D1117?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64," height="24" />

### 4. 4x Sub-Pixel Frosted Glass ClickGUI & HUD Layout Inspector
* **Responsive ClickGUI (`Right Shift`):** Features 5 animated categories (**Stream**, **HUD**, **Channel**, **Chat**, **Theme**), smooth quartic expansion, and **Dark Liquid Glass** / **AMOLED Obsidian** themes with 4 quality presets (`LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `ULTRA`).
* **Interactive HUD Editor:**
  * Drag and snap any HUD element to screen center guides; drag the bottom-right corner handle to resize dimensions.
  * **Mouse-Wheel Text Scaling:** Hover over the Live Chat box or any HUD element in the HUD Editor and **scroll the mouse wheel** to scale text size (`0.5x` – `2.6x`) in real time with a live animated preview.
  * **Right-Click Inspector Popup:** Right-click any HUD element to toggle Visibility, Lock Position, Frosted Background, Border Rim, Small Caps, Animations, Text Scale, and Corner Radius (`0px` – `18px`).
  * **4 Built-In HUD Profiles:** Switch instantly between **Default**, **Streaming**, **Gaming**, and **Minimal** layouts.
